source: Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu / Al Jazeera
bullets_en: Political Tensions Rise in Warangal West Over Resignation Challenge.
Drinking water supply restored in Thiruvananthapuram.
Poll finds US voters want government to end Iran war regardless of terms.
Under Nishant’s leadership, the future of the party remains bright for next 30 years.
Mumbai Police announce traffic curbs for VBA’s Samvidhan Samman Mahasabha at Shivaji Park.
bullets_ur: Istefy ke chailenge par Warangal West mein siyasi tanhao barh gaya hai.
Thiruvananthapuram mein peenay ke pani ki farahmi bahal kar di gayi hai.
Poll ke mutabiq American voters chahtay hain ke hukumat sharaet se qata-e-nazar Iran jang khatam kare.
Nishant ki qayadat mein party ka mustaqbil aglay 30 saal tak roshan rahega.
Mumbai Police ne Shivaji Park par VBA ke Samvidhan Samman Mahasabha ke liye trafah pabandiyon ka elaan kiya hai.
